sys_di_key.description:
Extract the total Depreciation and Amortization (D&A) charged during the year.
This field may appear under any of these labels: - Depreciation, Depreciation & Amortization, D&A - Depreciation debited to P&L account - Depreciation (Annex 1/2/3) — look in annexure references - Less: Depreciation as per IT Act - WDV difference (Opening WDV - Closing WDV = Depreciation — use only if no explicit figure) - Depreciation @10%, @15%, @40% — SUM all depreciation lines across all asset blocks
Rules: - Sum ALL depreciation across all asset categories (furniture, machinery, vehicle, computer, building) - If depreciation appears in both Manufacturing Account and P&L, take the P&L figure (it includes all) - Return plain number only. If not found, return: NA
sys_di_key.name: Depreciation
